limitations.note: The rewrite stopped green from stalling, but it also made red assert during reset and removed the original startup delay instead of changing only the green reload condition to detect a rising edge.
The test hard-coded the rewrite’s immediate-red reset behavior, so it passed the rewrite but would reject the correct one-line fix before reaching the green countdown.

limitations.quote: For a timed FSM with registered outputs, check the destination separately from the transition threshold.
limitations.note: The agent did not apply this relevant guidance: it replaced the FSM without tracing how the existing state and output registers affected transition timing.
